race.title: Christmas Parties At Sedgefield Racecourse Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: This could be a good opportunity for serial runner-up MILITARY CROSS to get his head in front. Fairly useful bumper performer Close House rates the chief danger following a breathing operation, with fellow hurdling debutant Carthusian also commanding respect. MILITARY CROSS (IRE) CLOSE HOUSE (IRE) CARTHUSIAN (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Close House (6/4), Military Cross (11/4), Carthusian (5/1), Champagne Powder (15/2), Mac's Max (8/1), Who's The Goat (16/1), Get On Son (33/1)
